description: RFieldMesh is an independent open-source scientific application for generating reproducible spatial random fields and assigning them safely to finite-element models. Version 1.0.0 provides spectral and covariance/Karhunen-Loeve simulation, physical-property marginal transformations, Abaqus input-file inspection and source-preserving rewriting, batch generation, offline visualization, a command-line interface, and a PySide6 desktop application.
notes: RFieldMesh is independent software and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Dassault Systemes.
title: RFieldMesh: Reproducible spatial random fields for finite-element meshes
